poppkflow: structured, iterative population PK workflow with nlmixr2

poppkflow-package.Rd

Population PK model development is a loop: specify a model, fit it, diagnose it, compare it with its parent, decide, and modify. poppkflow supports this loop with

Details

  • declarative model specifications (pk_spec(), pk_add_iiv(), pk_add_cov(), ...), compiled to nlmixr2 code (pk_compile()),

  • a run ledger (ledger/runs.csv plus RDS files per run) filled by pk_run(), with caching, lineage and an audit trail (pk_history(), pk_tree(), pk_audit()),

  • a standard diagnostics bundle and rule-based flags (pk_diagnostics(), pk_flags(), pk_suggest()),

  • comparison and decisions with rationale (pk_compare(), pk_decide()),

  • covariate screening and stepwise covariate modelling (pk_screen_covariates(), pk_scm()),

  • robustness checks (pk_multistart(), pk_repro()),

  • evaluation (pk_bootstrap(), pk_vpc(), pk_exposure()), and

  • reporting from the ledger (pk_report()).
